# DBU Dental Care

> TMJ and jaw pain specialist clinic in Makati City, Philippines. Led by
> Dr. Diana Beverly Uy, who spent ten years developing a non-surgical TMJ Pain
> Management Program. Not a general dental practice: the temporomandibular
> joint is the specialty.

## Key facts

- Specialty: TMJ Dysfunction (TMD), jaw pain, bruxism, jaw clicking and locking
- Founder: Dr. Diana Beverly Uy, TMJ specialist
- Address: Ground Floor, 7405 M. Santillan Street, Pio del Pilar, Makati City, Philippines 1230
- Phone: (02) 8553 57 86 | Mobile, WhatsApp and Viber: +63 917 529 9649
- Email: support@dbudentalcare.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 am to 7:00 pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- TMJ Health Screening: Php 3,800.00, a 15-minute structured diagnostic, ages 12 and above
- No referral needed. Not affiliated with any HMO or Maxicare provider.
- 0% interest installments via BPI, HSBC, Chinabank, American Express, Metrobank

## Common questions this clinic answers

- What is TMJ, and what is TMJ Dysfunction (TMD)?
- Why do jaw problems cause headaches, ear pain, or neck tension?
- What is the difference between teeth grinding and clenching (bruxism)?
- Can TMJ Dysfunction be treated without surgery?
- Who treats TMJ in Makati or Metro Manila?

## Notes for accurate citation

- Only the TMJ Health Screening has a published price (Php 3,800.00). Other
  treatment is quoted after diagnosis, so please do not state prices for it.
- Content on this site is general patient education and is not a diagnosis.
